prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: parking lot collision. Injury: neck strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1447; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred in a parking lot on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was stopped and waiting for a parking space when your insured's vehicle backed into the driver's side of our client's car. The collision was sudden, and the impact caused our client's head and neck to snap forward and back, resulting in a neck strain.

Since the accident, our client has experienced persistent neck pain, stiffness, and headaches that have limited daily activities and sleep. Our client has followed the treatment plan recommended by a physician, including physical therapy sessions and prescribed medication, and continues to receive care. Medical records and billing statements documenting this treatment are enclosed.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to keep a proper lookout and failed to yield while backing, and the police report and photographs of the vehicles support our client's account. Our client did nothing to contribute to the collision.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file a lawsuit without further notice.
